title: Who will hold the men's outdoor mile world record immediately after the 2026 London Diamond League meeting?
background: The London meeting is part of the annual Diamond League track-and-field series.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : World Athletics reports or reputable contemporaneous news coverage of the London Diamond League meeting on July 18, 2026. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the athlete credited as the men's outdoor mile world-record holder at the conclusion of the meeting. If no new world record is set, resolve to the existing record holder. Later administrative ratification is not required if the performance is reported as a world record. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The athlete's full name.
